<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant monoisotopic peak followed by rapidly decreasing M+1, M+2, etc., spaced ~1 Da apart—the only element whose isotopic distribution can be definitively recognized is carbon (C). No characteristic 2 Da chlorine/bromine pattern or significant sulfur, chlorine, bromine, etc., peaks are present.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
